profile.name: Kunimitsu
profile.overview: Kunimitsu is a fast, evasive, poking oriented character with excellent pressure tools and mixup options. Her pokes in neutral are fast and difficult to deal with, since most of them have multiple extensions, making it difficult to challenge her. This "death by a thousand cuts" playstyle is supplemented by her 3 main stances (Setsunagake, Katon, and Backturn), as well as strong crouching and standing low attacks.
profile.playstyle: Fast, evasive and pressure-heavy. Poke with quick strings that have many extensions, so the opponent is scared to press, then mix them up from back-turned (BT), Katon (KAT) and Setsunagake (SET). Wavu warns most of her moves lose to sidesteps to her right.
strengths: Strong pressure: She has poke strings with a million different extensions, making her very risky to press into should she choose to finish any of them.
Stance Macabre: Plethora of mixup options from 3 different stances, as well as full crouch.
Unparriable: Most of her key moves cannot be parried due to them being weapon attacks.

Hard to punish: Her pokes recover extremely quickly on whiff, and despite her string enders being punishable on block, it's very hard to react with the appropriate punish since she can delay or cancel most of them.
Evasive: A surprising amount of her moves have high and/or low crushing properties.

God-tier punishment: She has a wide variety of punishment options for every situation (most of which transition into her stances), including a bufferable i14 instant tornado launcher (CD2), and a high-execution wallsplatting i10 punish (ff+4,2).
A menace at any range: Her f+3 is essentially a neutral skip, and her qcf+1 still hits from full screen.
Her school outfit looks really cool
weaknesses: Steppable: Most of her moves are weak to sidestep right, and the select few options that do cover that side can usually be stepped the left.
Weak backdash: While her head still moves decently far back and many of her safe moves have pushback, her backdash overall is weaker than most characters.
Tricky to learn: It takes a lot of practice to properly navigate all of her stances without becoming predictable.
Mediocre damage: Her pokes aren't too damaging by themselves, meaning she has to win a lot more interactions to keep a life lead.
